title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
description: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

title: Win or lose, independent candidates want to meet voters in the middle
description: Nearly 200 independent candidates in more than 100 congressional races are trying to prove there's an alternative to the two party system — even though the chance of winning is very low.

title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
description: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.

title: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
description: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.

title: Montana ballot measure could undo ruling on corporate spending in state politics
description: Montana voters will have a chance to speak out on the boom of corporate and anonymous money in politics that has been the result of the Citizens United court ruling.

title: New White House press secretary a 'devoted fan' of Trump and MAGA
description: Katie Zacharia worked for one of Trump's companies and raised her profile appearing on conservative-leaning talk shows. She also amplified right-wing conspiracy theories. Now she'll be the president's chief spokesperson.

title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
description: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

title: Democratic senator talks Trump's Russian diesel deal
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Democratic Senator Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire about President Trump's deal for Russian diesel and his claim of an "energy ceasefire" that did not materialize.

title: Political strategist on how Trump's personal grievances could affect the GOP
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political strategist and former senior Republican congressional adviser Rina Shah about how President Trump's personal grievances and projects are affecting the chances of GOP candidates in the upcoming election.

title: Trump struggles to show voters he's focused on the cost of living
description: With a deal to import millions of tons of diesel fuel from Russia,  President Trump is struggling to show voters that he is focused on the cost of living ahead of the midterms.
